title: [Feature Request] Configurable autocompact context %
body: In addition to having auto-compaction be a configuration option, it would be useful to have the context % at which it is triggered
author: stevennevins

top_comments.author: gerrywastaken
top_comments.body: I asked for something similar but in the sdk: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-sdk-python/issues/97

top_comments.author: gerrywastaken
top_comments.body: Upon further reflection, I wonder if it is better for Anthropic to let the context grow to 95% before compacting, as that would mostly be a cache hit on their end. The reason I wanted this is that responses seem to slow as the context grows, but perhaps the resource usage is better for them, which may be why they increased it to 95 in the first place (if cache writes are relatively expensive compared to reads).
